documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Disclosure Under Regulation - 7 (1) (B) Of SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Tinna Rubber reported record quarterly profitability for Q1 FY27, with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores and PAT surpassing INR20 crores. The company is executing a strategic expansion plan, including increasing tire crushing capacity and commissioning new facilities for pyrolysis oil and construction chemicals. Management maintains a revenue target of INR670-700 crores for FY27 and aims for long-term EBITDA margins between 18% and 20%. The company is also expanding its global footprint with new projects in South Africa, Saudi Arabia, and Chile. Tinna Rubber reported record quarterly profitability for Q1 FY27, with consolidated EBITDA exceeding Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to stabilize between 18% and 20% for the year.
guidance.quote: though we wish to maintain the kind of margin profile, what we have achieved in the Q1, but to stabilize somewhere 18 plus to 20 in between as we feel is achievable.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching INR1,000 crores in revenue by FY29.
guidance.quote: we are targeting presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29

guidance.claim: The PCMB division is expected to contribute 10% of FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: With enhanced manufacturing capabilities and strong business momentum, this division is expected to contribute 10% of FY '27 revenue.

guidance.claim: The pyrolysis TPO and rCB business is expected to contribute 7% to 10% of total revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: Approximately about 7% to 10% of total revenue will come from the pyrolysis TPO RCB business.

guidance.claim: The PCMB business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.
guidance.quote: This business vertical is expected to contribute around 10% to FY27 revenue.

guidance.claim: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve approximately 30% volume growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: The steel abrasives business is expected to achieve ~30% volume growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects 20% to 25% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: What I can tell you on overall revenue is we are expecting about 20% to 25% growth in revenue in FY27 from the previous year.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve revenue of INR 1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.
guidance.quote: We aim to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores while maintaining EBITDA margins of over 18%.

demand_outlook.claim: The infrastructure segment grew by 7% in Q1 FY27, supported by demand for rubberized bitumen.
demand_outlook.quote: The Infrastructure segment delivered 7% revenue growth in Q1 FY27, supported by increased bituminous road surfacing activity.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects 50% volume growth in the Steel Abrasive business during FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: With customer transition underway from Q4 FY27, we remain confident of achieving approximately 50% volume growth in our Steel Abrasive business during FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The industrial segment is experiencing robust growth driven by high virgin polymer prices.
demand_outlook.quote: However, we are seeing very robust growth in our industrial sector. That is driven by, due to these crisis, the benefit that we have seen is there is higher motivation for blending of rubber in bitumen as well as for use of recycled rubber materials in new products.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure segment demand may face temporary softness in Q1 and Q2 due to bitumen availability issues.
demand_outlook.quote: One is we expect some reduction possibly in the infra business during Q1, Q2 of this year. And that is probably, it will be because of less availability of bitumen.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to spend INR100 crores on capex across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q1 of FY27, we have executed INR27 crores of capex as part of our broader investment plan of around INR100 crores across FY27 and '28

capex_expansion.claim: The MRP capacity expansion is on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to capitalize around INR60 crores of capex during FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of INR100 crores, we would be capitalizing around INR60 crores during FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The ongoing 3,500 MTPA MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 FY27, increasing the Company's total MRP capacity to 20,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed Rs. 27 Cr of capex in Q1 FY27 against a planned investment of Rs. 100 Cr over FY27–FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Completed Rs. 27 Cr. of capex in Q1 FY27 against the planned ~Rs. 100 Cr. investment over FY27–FY28.

capex_expansion.claim: The company earmarked INR 100 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain committed to investing in the business and have earmarked a further INR100 crores of capex over FY27 and '28.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its polymer compounding facility in Haryana to 18,000 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our expansion strategy, we are enhancing the capacity of our polymer compounding facility in Haryana, which is expected to reach 18,000 tons per annum by the end of Q1 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q1 FY27 exceeded 21%.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, we achieved record financial performance with EBITDA exceeding INR30 crores, PAT surpassing INR20 crores, EBITDA margins of over 21% and PAT margins of more than 13% on both stand-alone and consolidated basis.

margins_costs.claim: The company attributes margin expansion to operational efficiencies and a higher share of value-added products.
margins_costs.quote: This performance is the outcome of our sustained focus over the past few years on enhancing profitability through operational efficiencies, cost discipline and increasing share of value-added products.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved robust EBITDA margins of over 17% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: FY26 was another year of strong execution for Tinna Rubber, despite geopolitical uncertainties and a dynamic operating environment, we achieved record tire processing volumes and delivered robust EBITDA margins of over 17%.

margins_costs.claim: Nearly 50% of power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards.
margins_costs.quote: Nearly 50% of our power requirements are expected to be met through renewable sources from FY27 onwards, supporting both our ESG objectives and cost efficiency efforts.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a 15,000 tons rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The company also secured a 15,000 tons of rubberized bitumen processing order for execution in FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: Current tire crushing capacity in India is 185,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: We currently have a tire crushing capacity of 185,000 tons per annum in India

orders_capacity.claim: Tire-crush capacity in India reached 185,000 tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to strengthen our processing capabilities during FY26 and expanded our tire-crush capacity in India by 9% to 185,000 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The Varale plant has reached 80% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The Varale plant, the newest of our plants, has now reached capacity utilization of 80%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allocated INR5 crores towards R&D in FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We had mentioned in the past, and we are renewing our commitment to innovation by allocating INR5 crores towards research and development in FY '27.

capital_allocation.claim: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31 March 2026 was fully monetized in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The inventory of accrued EPR credits up to 31 March 2026 was fully monetized in Q1 FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Rs. 5 Cr was allocated to R&D for FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 5 Cr. was allocated to R&D for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 3.25 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders, I am pleased to inform the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR3.25 per equity share for FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt declined 10% to INR 121 crores in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Balance sheet strength improved in FY26 with debt declining 10% to INR121 crores from INR134 crores in the previous financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia conflict impacted operations in Oman and increased raw material costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While profitability had been impacted in the recent quarters by elevated raw material costs and the ongoing Middle East crisis, the implementation of corrective measures, including raw material import into Oman has led to a meaningful recovery in margins and overall profitability during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The consumer segment faced volume declines due to raw material price increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Consumer segment was impacted in quarter 1 due to a sharp increase in raw material prices following the West Asia conflict, along with import/export disruption affecting the availability of key imported raw material to the turfing industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region continue to impact the broader industry and project timelines.
risks_headwinds.quote: Management has prudently revised the project implementation timeline in light of evolving geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia and the GCC region, as ongoing supply chain and logistics disruptions continue to impact the broader industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs and export disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Performance in Oman was impacted by higher raw material costs during the year and export disruptions arising from geopolitical tensions in Middle East during the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company delayed capital works in Saudi Arabia due to Middle East tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to the Middle East tensions, we thought it prudent to delay the commencement of the capital works and we are closely monitoring the situation.

management_commitments.claim: Commissioning of 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion.
management_commitments.quote: The ongoing 3,500 metric ton per annum MRP capacity expansion is progressing as planned and remains on track for commissioning by Q3 of FY '27
we are targeting presence across 10 locations and revenue of INR1,000 crores by FY29
Out of INR100 crores, we would be capitalizing around INR60 crores during FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Recovered Carbon Black production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Recovered Carbon Black (rCB) production is scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27, followed by operational stabilization and commercial sales in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Construction of the Saudi Arabia plant is expected to begin in mid-FY27.
management_commitments.quote: A 13,000-square-metre plot has been allocated to Tinna, with construction expected to begin in mid-FY27, subject to normalization of the situation in the Middle East.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to invest INR 100 crores in capex.
management_commitments.quote: So over next 2 years, another INR100 crores of capex is foreseen by us.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects both pyrolysis and rCB plants to be in full operation.
management_commitments.quote: we expect both the plants to be in full operation by Q3 of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
